lidar.scan_pattern: non-repeating low-discrepancy solid-angle coverage; not Livox firing sequence
lidar.scan_timing: instantaneous snapshot; all hit timestamps equal simulation capture time
limitations: no rolling-scan motion distortion or IMU
collision geometry only; visual-only, particle and deformable obstacles unsupported

collision.scope: Robot versus environment only; self contacts excluded; evaluator-only truth

obstacle.scope: Evaluator fixture; known schedule/geometry never supplied to planner
obstacle.crossing_distance_rule: 1.0 m for X route; 1.3 m for Y route, fixed world-yaw vehicle
obstacle.initial_motion: physical actuator startup from rest; measured transient retained

source_dataset.teacher_future_fields: gt_* and teacher_*: evaluator/label audit only, forbidden model inputs
source_dataset.data_time_semantics: fixed physical future times from latest history anchor; positions are the reference commands of the accepted native teacher rollout; teacher_actual_positions stores executed physical positions separately; no arc-length resampling, no terminal goal clamp

sensor.direction_pattern: MID360 envelope approximation, not Livox timing or optics

geometry_config.coordinate_frame: one current measured body origin and goal-yaw frame
geometry_config.algorithm: measured endpoint occupancy and sampled measured-return ray traversal
geometry_config.no_return_rays: remain unknown, no max-range free ray
geometry_config.limitation: Sampling may miss grazing cells; free evidence does not certify voxel volume.

start_velocity_support.representation: Exact initial derivative; this alone is not evidence of moving-start training.
